Hi Jordan / Priya,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — really appreciate the deep interest from ACME on the private deployment options. As discussed, the right next step is a technical architecture deep-dive so our SEs can walk through VPC/on-prem connectivity, network requirements, and IAM/integration patterns with your SSO/KMS.

Attendees we suggest:
- Jordan Lee (ACME) - Infrastructure lead
- Priya Sinha (ACME) - Security
- Matt O'Connor (ACME) - Procurement (informational)
- Dev Patel (Redwood) - Solutions Engineer
- Ethan Park (Redwood) - Infrastructure Engineer
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) - AE / owner

Proposed agenda (30-45m):
1) Goals and success criteria (5m)
2) High-level deployment modes: VPC peering vs Private Connect vs on-prem package (10m)
3) Network & firewall requirements, egress patterns (10m)
4) IAM, KMS and audit logging (10m)
5) Q&A / next steps (5-10m)

Available windows for our team this week (PST):
- Thu Mar 5: 9:00-11:00 or 2:00-4:00
- Fri Mar 6: 11:00-1:00

If those don't work, please share 2x 30-45m slots that work for you and we'll coordinate internally. I've attached a short checklist (redwood-onprem-checklist.xlsx) and a quick VPC questions doc for your security team.

Thanks,

- Marissa Cole
